cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - RoundedBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with vertical edges rounded
Default: edge_style = f Finger Joint: ![Finger Joint](static/samples/RoundedBox-2.jpg)
Alternative: edge_style = h Edge (parallel Finger Joint Holes): ![Finger Joint Holes](static/samples/RoundedBox-3.jpg)
With lid:
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RoundedBox --x 120 --y 120 --sh 80 --edge_style F --wallpieces 3 --outside 0 --thickness 3 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes RoundedBox --x --y --sh --edge_style --wallpieces --outside --reference --labels
